records.localization_note: Rafael Castor has a distinct fixed selector for his silence and smile. He is separate from the FI address Sera gives to Hodram.
Hodram Bergstrom is the captain's nameplate. Sera learns his given name through the source-preserved FI substitutions.
Janus Pasar recognizes the workshop and suggests using its methods to improve ship armor.
Camille Overijssel is the approved nameplate. Charles remembers him as the person with Lil. Hodram uses the given name when accepting his apology.
Cesare Tony is the alternative workshop speaker whose deliberate syllable-by-syllable praise differs from the other crew voices.
Gerhard Adernkatz remains the counterpart in the Guiding Staff debate and the officer giving the recruiting lesson. His discussion of the ship and maps stays formal.
Charles Rochefort challenges the use of the Guiding Staff and teaches trade controls. The technical language in his different discoveries suits his own voice.
Manuel Almeida handles supplies and has his own version of the advice about Sera. His easy tone is distinct from Gerhard's.
Sera Shahrbaraz is the short nameplate. Her full name appears in dialogue only when she introduces herself. The earlier caption is embedded in the FE body.
Julian Lopes makes a joke out of his own tavern advice and has his own more casual interpretation of the bamboo plan.
Zamorin Nagarpur is the existing full nameplate. Hodram calls him Nagarpur in speech and the chapter supplies no new personal name.
Diogo Escante is the short nameplate. Diogo de Escante is the approved full name in the introductions and retains the separate catalogue component.
Jorge Albacete speaks the angry rebuke before Diogo dismisses him. The existing full nameplate identifies the separate speaker.
Barkeep is the shared familiar role for the tavern worker who overhears the discussion, asks about Sera and tells the story about the jar.
Port Worker fits the occupation of the man warning about the southern Mediterranean. The warning supplies no name or rank.
Guildmaster identifies Diogo's introducer at the guild. The role stays distinct from the governor he introduces.
Sailor is the established generic label for the workshop voice. The role-7 lookout remains separate and uses its original voice table.
